purpose: Compatibility adapter from dashboard conversation to bounded AnalystAgent and shared typed decision situation brief.
consumers: trader/dashboard/server.py:463 /api/chat constructs engine per request; tests/test_chat_agent.py and tests/test_owner_interface_boundary.py verify no control writes. Readers: owner query via situation_brief; writer: BrainLLM usage accounting only when enabled.
evidence: Full 59-line module: handle/ask delegate to agent; situation_brief calls owner.queries.query with the same configured authority; evidence/consulted return list copies. datetime_today retained as historical import-compatible UTC helper; no static caller found, not removed solely on that basis.
design_boundary: SDD25/Stage8 grounded evidence, SDD26/35.14 no implicit control authority. Historical talk-to-Luffy spec ops interception is superseded by explicit gateway safety contract. config.yaml brain.enabled=false intentionally contains provider admission.
costs_removal: One engine/request; no background process or knowledge retention. Brief is bounded by owner query. Lists are shallow copies (no durable evidence rewriting). Removing compatibility entrypoints risks external/historical callers without measurable gain.

purpose: Bounded conversational read loop with exact consulted owner records, refusal fallback and no operations authority.
consumers: Dashboard engine is runtime caller. owner.queries.query reads retained journal/research/learning/portfolio/approval evidence; BrainLLM.chat_tools uses purpose=chat. tests/test_chat_agent.py + tests/test_stage8_owner_os.py exercise scripted provider messages and refusal.
evidence: Baseline _exec accepted every legacy registry tool and forwarded arbitrary query kwargs despite GROUNDED_SCHEMAS finite contract. Baseline repro shows undeclared root reaches query. Now dispatch accepts owner_query only, JSON object and declared kind/identity/offset only; cfg remains engine controlled. _grounded requires at least one consulted record citation; this is a citation-presence gate, not semantic proof for each sentence.
design_boundary: SDD25/Stage8 exact evidence-backed answers; SDD26 bounded typed tools/no arbitrary paths; SDD35.14 typed authenticated controls remain owner gateway responsibility. Read-only chat never changes FROZEN/Risk/Execution state.
costs_removal: Default 5 provider tool rounds plus one forced final answer; six history snippets capped 400 chars, tool argument telemetry capped 300 chars. No retries, queue, new provider use or retained memory introduced. Per-record/query bounds are enforced by owner queries; step count does not independently cap all reply bytes/tool-call cardinality. Simplification closes dispatch divergence and removes a redundant registry dispatch branch.
inspection: Full source and concrete consumer/test bodies inspected offline; baseline 4deca5c275c30c2c59c227b5170bab651cf777fe retained; new regression baseline counterexamples captured.

purpose: Legacy read-only compatibility helper/schema registry and canonical finite owner_query schema.
consumers: Canonical agent advertises GROUNDED_SCHEMAS; direct legacy helper consumers found in tests/test_chat_agent.py (retained as compatibility, not dead-code proof). Journal SQL reads trades, decisions, strategies, equity and agent_accuracy. owner_query helper delegates to shared evidence authority. get_pnl now reuses dashboard.economics.journal_pnl/booking_receipts.
evidence: All helper bodies and schemas reviewed. Parameterized symbol/status filters; bounded trades 100, decisions 50, equity 200, strategy catalog 20; get_pnl all-time scan and get_agent_stats window remain unbounded by row count. Baseline null PNL became numeric zero; retained UNKNOWN receipts could also be overridden by scalar zero. Existing classifier now determines aggregate unknown/estimated/booked status, unknown totals/rates/PF remain None; explicit unknown count and whole_trade_complete=false. No new accounting logic.
design_boundary: SDD25/27 exact financial evidence and historical replay; NULL/UNKNOWN cannot become fabricated zero. Legacy helpers remain callable for compatibility, while Stage8 runtime uses only owner_query. SQL-only helper fields do not carry exact owner evidence identities and are intentionally unavailable to runtime agent.
costs_removal: Existing all-time PNL scan plus uncapped booking-receipt reads per trade is O(trades + receipts) data and O(trades) SQL queries; disconnected canonical runtime, no scheduler or added retention. This is cost of reusing authoritative evidence classification, not duplicated economics. Do not remove historical helper interfaces from static-reference evidence alone.
inspection: Full source and concrete consumer/test bodies inspected offline; baseline 4deca5c275c30c2c59c227b5170bab651cf777fe retained; new regression baseline counterexamples captured.

purpose: Optional synchronous Telegram HTML alert sender; bool delivery acknowledgement, not journal or control authority.
consumers: Kernel constructs Telegram using Env.telegram and sends alerts after entry outcome updates, recovery records, exit results and confirmed macro state transitions. engine/reconcile.py flatten_all sends result completeness summary; analyst/TV/RentKeeper send qualified lifecycle/advisory messages. Kernel owns polling and adapter dispatch, owner.service owns controls.
evidence: Full 34-line baseline inspected. configured requires token+chat; send uses requests.post timeout=10, retains intentional HTML used by kernel <b> alerts. Baseline returned HTTP ok even Bot API body rejected; baseline request exception logged URL token. Now requires API ok=true and logs exception class only. Sender does not claim current venue verification.
design_boundary: SDD25 alerts, SDD26 secret isolation, SDD35.14 gateway authority. Existing sender formats supplied state only and does not query/mutate canonical stores. Audit inspected Kernel._risk_step/_macro_step/_macro_release/_manage_one/_drain_close_requests and engine.reconcile.flatten_all consumers without changing their authority.
costs_removal: At most one synchronous request/send, 10s timeout, no retry or durable queue; unconfigured returns False. API acknowledgement proves accepted message, not owner receipt or current system state. Caller message correctness remains producer responsibility. Delivery/HTML failures return False; no new alert ledger, outbox, retries or polling replacement added.
inspection: Full source and concrete consumer/test bodies inspected offline; baseline 4deca5c275c30c2c59c227b5170bab651cf777fe retained; new regression baseline counterexamples captured.
